title: Briefing for 2026-10-09
intro: Good morning. Here is your briefing for 2026-10-09: US markets, global news, and the Philippines, in five minutes.
us: Inflation on many everyday items was entirely due to tariffs, NY Fed says. Inflation fears on the rise as one-year outlook in Fed survey hits highest level since May 2023. ICE came to town and left behind weakened economies. Why AI is both the hope and the hazard for world leaders, according to IMF chief Georgieva. India’s central bank hikes rates for the first time since 2023 as inflation risks build. Trade deficit hits $105.6 billion, widest since just before Trump tariffs enacted last year.
global: Christa Pike now walking after failed US execution, lawyer tells BBC. Protesters blame 'vulture funds' for Spain's housing crisis. 'Bold and inventive' Canadian poet Anne Carson wins Nobel Literature Prize. US deportations to African countries unlawful and exploit suffering, rights group says. Chrysler Building to get its crown restored after being sold. How oil-rich Alberta's economy might fare if it broke away from Canada.
philippines: Rodrigo Duterte fit for trial, says ICC. Mark Villar joins Senate majority | The wRap. LIVE UPDATES: Impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte. Rappler Live Jam: Charlie Lim.
outro: That's your briefing. Have a great day.
